notes.title: Shark Coin Party Video Award！
notes.content:
Event Time
The Event starts on UTC Jul 22, end on Aug 4.

Event Content
We welcome any players to make interesting video about Shark Coin Party. No matter it is a review, gameplay experience or tutorial!

Event Reward
At the end of the event, we will give away reward according to views of the video.
Any video has enough views(>5000) can get the base prize award. For videos reaches 5000 views, according to views count, extra award will be given to the video maker!
Top 1 Prize
$100
Top 2 Prize
$75
Top 3 Prize
$50

How to Join the Event
Leave comment below with your video link! We will count the views at the end of the event!
Prize Award Payment
We will contact you through Youtube message if you win the prize.
